meta.name: ai-provider-elevenlabs
meta.description: ElevenLabs voice AI SDK patterns for TypeScript/Node.js -- text-to-speech, streaming, voice cloning, speech-to-speech, pronunciation control, and conversational AI

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 ElevenLabs 语音 AI 构建语音合成与克隆功能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要在 Node.js 项目里集成 ElevenLabs 语音能力
copy.tagline_en: Build voice synthesis and cloning with ElevenLabs AI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate ElevenLabs voice AI into your Node.js project

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能调用 ElevenLabs 语音 AI，将文本转为语音、流式播放、克隆声音、进行语音转语音转换，并支持实时对话 AI。
howto.when: 当你要求生成语音（如朗读文本、配音），或需要实时语音交互、克隆声音时触发。

say.text: 用 George 的声音把这段话读出来。
克隆这段录音里的声音，然后用它说“你好”。
say.note: Claude 会先创建声音克隆，再生成语音。

say.text: 用流式播放低延迟语音：欢迎使用应用。
say.note: Claude 会使用 stream() 方法实时输出音频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use ElevenLabs voice AI to convert text to speech, stream audio, clone voices, perform speech-to-speech conversion, and support real-time conversational AI.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate speech (e.g., read text, narrate), need real-time voice interaction, or clone a voice.

say_en.text: Read this text aloud using George's voice.
say_en.note: Claude will call textToSpeech.convert to generate audio.

say_en.text: Clone the voice from this recording, then say 'hello' with it.
say_en.note: Claude will create a voice clone first, then generate speech.

say_en.text: Stream low-latency audio: Welcome to the application.
say_en.note: Claude will use the stream() method for real-time output.
